'''Mericci''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Battalion/Legends|Battalion]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he participated in the [[Battle of Corellia]], but was pulled out along with the rest of Imperial forces following the [[Darth Malgus]]'s [[New Empire|coup]]. He made a temporary stop at the [[Vaiken Spacedock]], where he urged fellow Imperials to assist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Adele Konya]] in the still ongoing [[Battle for the Black Hole]].
